tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.description: A tenant is one customer organization. It sees only the Falcon CIDs linked to it.
tenants.empty: No tenants yet. A tenant is one customer organization: you link Falcon CIDs and users to it, and it sees only its own data.
tenants.moreCids: {count, plural, one {# more CID} other {# more CIDs}}

create.title: New tenant
create.description: Give the customer organization a name. You can link Falcon CIDs now or later.
create.name: Tenant name

rename.title: Rename tenant
rename.description: Users see the new name straight away.
rename.name: Tenant name

cids.title: CIDs of {name}
cids.description: This tenant sees only the findings of the CIDs listed here.
cids.label: Falcon CIDs
cids.help: One CID per line. A CID has 32 hexadecimal characters. A CID can belong to one tenant only.
cids.count: {count, plural, =0 {No CIDs} one {# CID} other {# CIDs}}

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: This permanently deletes the tenant, its findings and its CIDs, and removes every user from it. Users who belong to no other tenant can no longer see any data. This cannot be undone.

notices.syncStarted: Sync started. This can take a few minutes.
notices.createdCidsFailed: Tenant created, but the CIDs were not saved. Open Edit CIDs to try again.

errors.exists: A tenant with this name already exists.
errors.cid_taken: One of these CIDs is already linked to another organization.
errors.invalid_cid: Each CID must have 32 hexadecimal characters.
errors.confirm_name: The name you typed does not match.
errors.no_cids: Link at least one CID to this tenant first.
errors.chat_taken: This group already belongs to another organization.
errors.invalid_chat: A chat ID may only contain letters, digits, - and _.

lineChat.title: LINE group of this organization
lineChat.description: News answers about this organization's devices, and only its own, are sent to this group, starting with "Your organization". Leave empty to have the details sent to the SOC chat instead.
lineChat.label: LINE group ID
lineChat.help: Add the bot to the organization's group, then type "id" there (the SOC dashboard answers with the group ID). The ID starts with C. One group can belong to one organization only.

team.description: Invite people, choose which tenants they can see, and manage who can sign in.

access.hidden: {count, plural, one {+# other organization} other {+# other organizations}}

actions.cannotAdminister: This user also belongs to another organization. Remove them from yours with Edit access instead.
actions.isSelf: You cannot do this to your own account.

confirm.deleteBody: {email} is deleted for good and signed out. This cannot be undone. To keep the account, disable it instead.

invite.description: They get a link to set a password and join. The link is shown here to copy; tick the box below to email it too.
invite.superAdminNote: A super admin sees every tenant and its CIDs and manages everything. Use this for your own staff only.
invite.tenantsHelp: Tick the tenants this user can see and choose their role in each. Admins manage users; operators can only read.
invite.noTenants: There is no tenant you can add users to.

errors.no_tenant: Choose at least one tenant for a member.

edit.description: Choose which tenants this user can see and their role in each.
edit.typeWarning: Changing the user type signs the user out.
edit.ownTypeLocked: You cannot change your own user type.
edit.removeAll: Saving with no tenant ticked removes this user from your tenants.

errors.no_tenant: A member needs at least one tenant.
errors.last_super_admin: There must be at least one super admin.

errors.shared_user: This user also belongs to another organization. Remove them from yours with Edit access instead.
errors.last_super_admin: There must be at least one super admin.

falcon.manageTenants: Manage CIDs under Organizations in Settings
